scope: One host, same principal in worker/coordinator roles; not real-model, independent-account, peer, managed-launch or installed-release qualification

artifact.source_changes: Working-tree build includes MCP schema numeric-annotation fix and in-progress managed client implementation; only unmanaged MCP/CLI path is qualified by real-model runs using this artifact.

clients.permission_note: Default headless and explicitly permissive scenarios are separate; Claude uses --bare
clients.provider_mode: scripted-loopback; no model service or real credentials

configuration.reason: Actual generated registration must expose a valid production handshake and exact pinned API tool registry

network_isolation.reason: Client loopback allowed, external raw IP denied; production daemon has separate loopback/Unix-only guard

initialize.reason: Valid JSON-RPC response, supported negotiated version, Locust serverInfo and tool capability required

tools_list.reason: Exact pinned API tool names, structured object schemas and coherent schema digest required

scoped_daemon_authentication.reason: Production bridge checked the enrolled non-owner credential; observed goal authority matches independent daemon setup

claim.reason: Actual bridge returned exact assignment, session instance and generation

progress.reason: Independent event read must match client-authored progress and principal

workspace_native_tool.reason: Client native command must execute the authored driver; the harness does not materialize/edit/submit/apply on its behalf

contribution_flow.reason: Independent task/event/head/binding and file observations agree with actual client-produced contribution

accepted_before_integrated.reason: Client-executed driver observed accepted head while source remained unchanged and integration was null

dirty_work_preserved.reason: Independent file/HEAD checks preserve untracked local work and original commit

held_wait.reason: Actual client's production wait was observed outstanding before leader-only SIGINT

interruption.reason: Natural exit of client session and identified observer/bridge; no forced cleanup counts as success

explicit_resume.reason: Same native session plus fresh independently read production note after daemon restart

bridge_restart.reason: New observed production bridge PID and committed resumed operation

daemon_restart.reason: Independent goal, task/assignment, claims, known progress and endpoint persist across SQLite restart; contribution head is optional

receipt_integrity.reason: Re-evaluated: parsed JSON-RPC 2.0 receipts have valid IDs and matched response method/tool correlation; interrupted requests may remain outstanding

client_execution.reason: Provider errors, client exits, timeouts and natural owned-process cleanup checked
